sources.title: MOSS-SoundEffect-V2.0 - Models
sources.snippet: MOSS-SoundEffect v2.0 is a text-to-audio model with a Diffusion Transformer (DiT) backbone trained with the Flow Matching objective, paired with a DAC VAE and a Qwen3 text encoder. It generates high-fidelity environmental, urban, creature, and human-action sound effects from natural-language prompts, with controllable duration up to 30 seconds at 48 kHz. 1. sources.title: awesome-ai-voice/models/moss-soundeffect.md at main - GitHub
sources.snippet: MOSS-SoundEffect is the dedicated text-to-sound model in the OpenMOSS / MOSI.AI MOSS-TTS family. It turns natural-language captions into high-fidelity non-speech audio (ambience, urban scenes, creatures, human actions, and short music-like clips).

sources.title: MOSS-SoundEffect: Text-to-Audio model — overview, use cases, alternatives
sources.snippet: Overview MOSS-SoundEffect is a text-to-audio model that generates environmental sound effects and ambient soundscapes from text descriptions. Built by OpenMOSS-Team, it is the specialized sound design layer of the MOSS-TTS Family, designed to complement speech synthesis with immersive contextual audio in production workflows.
